system.notes: Light machine gun, belt-fed 50 (c). Popular with merc units worldwide; the most common LMG model. Has a hip-brace recoil pad (Rating 1) and an ammunition bin slung over the shoulder. The only entry the book's Light Machine Guns section lists — there is no generic LMG. Light Machine Guns is a FIREARMS concentration (p.70); Gunnery governs heavy weapons "on tripods, vehicle mounts, pintles, or in fixed emplacements", so a VEHICLE-MOUNTED Valiant is fired with Gunnery even though the weapon itself is a firearm. SR2E p.238, p.255.
